title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 49 ]

items.text: He said to me, "I owe you an apology."
He told me that he owed me an apology.
He will ask, "Do you take a 100 dollar bill?"
He will ask if they take a 100 dollar bill.
The teller asked me, "Do you want large bills?"
The teller asked me if I wanted large bills.
The bank teller said, "You had better have an account with this bank."
The bank teller recommended I have an account with the bank.
She said, "This is a little something for you on your graduation."
She said that was a little something for me on my graduation.
He asked, "Don't you have any vacancies?"
He asked if they had any vacancies.
Lincoln said, "Honesty is the best policy."
Lincoln said that honesty is the best policy.
